description:
Sacrifice Tenacious Dead to Phyrexian Altar, generating {B}.
Pawn of Ulamog, Blood Artist, and Tenacious Dead trigger; stack the triggers to resolve in that order.
Pawn of Ulamog generates an Eldrazi Spawn token; sacrifice it to generate {1} (Blood Artist triggers again).
Resolve two Blood Artist triggers, draining opponent for 2.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from the graveyard.
Repeat the sacrifice-recursion loop, draining opponent infinitely with Blood Artist triggers.
